prompt: Ask the child to look at the letter shown and say its sound.
completion: Tazama herufi hii. Sasa, say the sound unayoiona!

prompt: Ask the child to read the syllable shown aloud.
completion: Hebu sasa soma syllable hii kwa sauti.

prompt: Ask the child to read the word shown aloud.
completion: Sawa, hebu usome neno hili kwa sauti!

prompt: Ask the child to read the paragraph aloud, at their own pace.
completion: Sawa, sasa soma kifungu hiki kwa sauti, pole pole.

prompt: Ask the child to read the story aloud from the beginning.
completion: Sawa! Sasa read hadithi hii kwa sauti kuanzia mwanzo.

prompt: Ask a simple comprehension question about the story just read.
completion: Great! Sasa niambie, hadithi hii ilikuwa inamhusu nani?

prompt: Ask the child to try reading the same item one more time.
completion: Hebu jaribu kuisoma tena. One more time!

prompt: Ask the child to slow down and read at a calmer pace.
completion: Soma polepole, take your time, usiache maneno.

prompt: Praise correct letter-sound on the first try.
completion: Hongera! Good job, umeitamka vizuri!

prompt: Praise correct syllable read on the first try.
completion: Vizuri! First try, umeisoma sawasawa!

prompt: Praise correct word read on the first try.
completion: Hongera! First try, umelisoma neno vizuri!

prompt: Praise fluent reading of a full paragraph.
completion: Umesoma kifungu vizuri sana. Great job!

prompt: Praise finishing a story with strong fluency.
completion: Umeisoma hadithi yote kwa ufasaha. Well done!

prompt: Praise the child for succeeding after a retry.
completion: Umeweza! Good job kwa kujaribu tena!

prompt: Praise the child for succeeding after a retry at syllable level.
completion: Umeisoma vizuri baada ya kujaribu tena. Well done!

prompt: Praise a thoughtful answer to a comprehension question.
completion: Vizuri sana! Jibu lako ni zuri, umefikiria vizuri!

prompt: Prompt the child to think of the sound the letter makes.
completion: Hebu fikiria: herufi hii ina sauti gani?

prompt: Prompt the child to blend the two sounds in the syllable together.
completion: Hebu unganisha sauti hizo mbili, then say them together.

prompt: Prompt the child to look at the first letter of the word.
completion: Angalia herufi ya kwanza. Inasema nini?

prompt: Suggest the word looks like one they already know.
completion: Neno hili linafanana na unalolijua. Try kukumbuka.

prompt: Suggest using the rest of the sentence as a clue for the tricky word.
completion: Soma sentensi yote; maneno mengine yatakupa clue.

prompt: Suggest thinking about what would make sense in the story so far.
completion: Fikiria story yetu. Neno gani linafaa hapa?

prompt: Suggest thinking back to what happened earlier in the story.
completion: Fikiria kidogo — nini kilitokea mwanzo wa hadithi?

prompt: Gently correct a misread letter sound without saying "wrong".
completion: Ulikaribia! Sikiliza sauti ya herufi hii: mmm. Try again.

prompt: Gently correct a misread syllable.
completion: Karibu! Hebu tusikie tena — sema "si", si "su".

prompt: Gently correct a misread word.
completion: Karibu! Hebu tujaribu tena, soma neno hili polepole.

prompt: Gently correct a misread sentence within a paragraph.
completion: Karibu! Hebu jaribu tena, soma sentensi polepole zaidi.

prompt: Model the correct pronunciation and ask the child to repeat it.
completion: Sikiliza: ‘shule.’ Sasa repeat after me: ‘shule.’

prompt: Gently correct a misunderstanding without discouraging the child.
completion: Hmm, hebu tusikie tena — jibu liko karibu sana!

prompt: Announce moving up from beginner to letter/syllable level.
completion: Hongera! Sasa tunaendelea na silabi. Are you ready?

prompt: Announce moving up from letter/syllable to word level.
completion: Hongera! Sasa tunaendelea kusoma maneno. Ready? Twende!

prompt: Announce moving up from word to paragraph level.
completion: Hongera! Sasa tutasoma kifungu kizima. Ready?

prompt: Announce moving up from paragraph to story level.
completion: Hongera! Sasa tutasoma hadithi nzima. Ready? Twende!

prompt: Reassure the child they're staying at beginner level to build confidence.
completion: Tutaendelea kufanya mazoezi ya sauti za herufi. You’re doing well!

prompt: Reassure the child they're staying at letter/syllable level.
completion: Tutaendelea kufanya mazoezi ya silabi. You’re doing well!

prompt: Encourage a child who seems to be losing focus or getting tired.
completion: Umefanya vizuri sana! Keep going, tunakaribia mwisho!

prompt: Reassure a child who seems frustrated after a few misses in a row.
completion: Usijali, baadhi ya maneno ni magumu. Keep trying, unaweza!

prompt: Reassure a shy or nervous-sounding child before they begin.
completion: Usiwe na wasiwasi; tuko pamoja. Ready? Tuanze!

prompt: Encourage the child partway through, noting they're doing this well.
completion: Umefika mbali! Keep it up, unaendelea vizuri!

prompt: Encourage the child before a noticeably harder item.
completion: Hili ni gumu kidogo, lakini unaweza. Ready?

prompt: Close out a normal session and tell the child what happens next.
completion: Hongera sana! Umefanya vizuri leo. Tutaendelea kesho, sawa?

prompt: Tell the child the session is being paused and can continue later.
completion: Tutapumzika hapa. Tutaendelea baadaye, okay?

prompt: Warmly end a session that's stopping earlier than planned.
completion: Umejitahidi leo! Tutaishia hapa na kuendelea wakati mwingine. Bye!

prompt: Nothing was heard. Ask the child to try again.
completion: Samahani, sikusikia. Please jaribu tena.

prompt: Audio was too quiet. Ask the child to speak a little louder.
completion: Sema tena, sauti kubwa zaidi kidogo!

prompt: Too much background noise. Ask the child to move somewhere quieter or closer to the phone.
completion: Kuna noise nyingi. Tafadhali sogea karibu na simu.

prompt: Alert the facilitator that repeated repair attempts have failed and their attention is needed now.
completion: Tafadhali saidia; repair attempts tatu zimeshindwa.

prompt: Report a technical fault to the facilitator in plain, factual terms.
completion: Kuna hitilafu ya kiufundi. Session haiwezi kuendelea sasa.

prompt: Ask the facilitator to confirm the assigned reading level before it takes effect.
completion: Tafadhali confirm kiwango cha kusoma kabla hakijahifadhiwa.

prompt: Report a brief factual summary of the session's results to the facilitator.
completion: Session imekamilika: maneno 18 sahihi, makosa 4 kwenye sauti za herufi.
